summary: The document is a non-functional placeholder containing seven highly ambiguous, unmeasurable statements for a food delivery mobile app. It lacks all standard software engineering artifacts, including scope, user roles, technical constraints, and acceptance criteria, rendering it completely unusable for development or testing.

risk_factors.title: Total Absence of Security Architecture
risk_factors.description: The document explicitly states 'No security requirements' and provides no guidance on authentication, authorization, data encryption, or payment security (PCI-DSS), leaving the system vulnerable to exploitation from day one.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define a comprehensive security architecture including OAuth2/OIDC for authentication, AES-256 for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit, and strict PCI-DSS compliance for the payment module.

risk_factors.title: Undefined Data Privacy and Compliance
risk_factors.description: No mention of GDPR, CCPA, or data retention policies. The app handles customer PII (addresses, phone numbers) and financial data without any privacy framework.
risk_factors.mitigation: Implement a Data Privacy Impact Assessment (DPIA), define data retention policies, and ensure explicit consent mechanisms for data collection and processing.

risk_factors.title: Unmeasurable Performance Requirements
risk_factors.description: Requirement 3 states 'Delivery should happen fast' without defining latency, throughput, or availability targets. This makes it impossible to design the backend infrastructure or load-test the system.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define specific NFRs: e.g., API response time < 200ms at 95th percentile, system availability 99.9%, and support for 10,000 concurrent users.

risk_factors.title: Ambiguous Payment Integration
risk_factors.description: Requirement 4 states 'Customers can pay somehow.' This is a critical business function with zero technical specification, leading to potential integration failures and financial loss.
risk_factors.mitigation: Specify the payment gateway (e.g., Stripe, PayPal), supported payment methods (credit card, wallet), and error handling/retry logic for failed transactions.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.context: 1. The app should be awesome. 2. Food ordering must be easy.
conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace subjective terms with measurable UX metrics: 'Ordering flow must be completed in no more than 3 taps' and 'App store rating target of 4.5 stars within 3 months of launch.'
Define specific restaurant features: 'Restaurants can update menu items, mark items as unavailable, and view real-time order status.'
Specify notification types and triggers: 'Push notifications for order confirmation, driver assignment, and delivery completion. Email notifications for receipts.'
Define MVP reporting requirements: 'Daily sales summary and order count reports for restaurant owners. Admin dashboard for platform-wide metrics.'

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Without defined roles (Customer, Restaurant Owner, Driver, Admin), it is impossible to design the authorization model or UI flows.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define RBAC matrix: Customer (order, pay, track), Restaurant (manage menu, accept orders), Driver (accept deliveries, update status), Admin (manage users, view analytics).

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: The document lacks any specific functional behaviors, making it impossible to develop or test the system.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Detailed user stories for each role, e.g., 'As a customer, I want to browse restaurants by cuisine type so I can find food I like.'

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No performance, scalability, availability, or security standards are defined, leading to potential system failure under load.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Specify latency, throughput, uptime, and security standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10 compliance).

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No information on how data will be stored or how the app will integrate with third-party services (maps, payments, SMS).
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define database schema for core entities (User, Restaurant, Order, Payment) and API contracts for external services.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Without acceptance criteria, developers and testers have no objective way to determine if a feature is complete.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Add Given/When/Then scenarios for each functional requirement, e.g., 'Given a customer has items in cart, When they tap pay, Then a payment sheet appears.'

ai_recommendations: Completely discard the current document and initiate a formal requirements gathering process with stakeholders to define specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound (SMART) requirements.
Establish a Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) from the outset to ensure every business goal is linked to a technical component, test case, and acceptance criterion.

Engage a security architect to define the security and privacy framework, including authentication, authorization, data encryption, and compliance with relevant regulations (GDPR, PCI-DSS), before any development begins.
